description: React Native component for a search screen in a food delivery app, handling restaurant search, recent searches, and UI updates.

methods.name: searchAllShops
methods.description: Filters restaurants based on search text using regex matching on keywords.

methods.name: getUniqueTags
methods.description: Extracts unique tags from the list of restaurants.

methods.name: emptyView
methods.description: Returns a React component to display when no search results are found.

methods.name: handleTagPress
methods.description: Sets the search state to the selected tag.

methods.name: handleClearRecentSearches
methods.description: Clears recent searches and updates state.

methods.name: renderTagsOrSearches
methods.description: Renders either search results, recent searches, or tags based on current state.
